summary: Independent adversarial review found no blocker or important issues. 60 rows map 1:1 to the 60 deposited RAW files; sample, fraction and experiment assignments reproduce the deposited MaxQuant design exactly; biology and technical metadata are supported by the PRIDE record, the paper (PMC10959978) and Cellosaurus. Only minor improvements remain.

reviewer_context.context: fresh reviewer agent without producer transcript; producer report.md not relied upon

spec_compliance.evidence: Official parse_sdrf validate-sdrf with -t ms-proteomics -t human -t cell-lines -t clinical-metadata --use_ols_cache_only: 'Everything seems to be fine', exit 0. sdrf-tools structure: OK. 61 lines x 44 fields, no CR/stray whitespace, no duplicate data files or assay names. Template set derived independently from templates.yaml: cell-lines requires technology+sample layers (ms-proteomics+human); clinical-metadata is the TERMS.tsv home of compound/dose, so its declaration is justified.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Resolved in local caches: invasive breast carcinoma (MONDO:0006256/NCIT:C9245), invasive lobular breast carcinoma (MONDO:0005051), pleural effusion (UBERON:0000175), epithelial cell (CL:0000066), estradiol (CHEBI:23965), ethanol (CHEBI:16236), enrichment of phosphorylated protein (EFO:0010806). MS:1002877 Q Exactive HF-X, MS:1001251 Trypsin, MS:1000422 beam-type CID (HCD), PRIDE:0000627 DDA, PRIDE:0000608 DTT, PRIDE:0000599 IAA, UNIMOD:4/35/1/21 correct labels and targets. sdrf-tools check --offline: CLEAN, 0 hallucinated/mismatched.

source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol names MCF7-wt, MCF7-Y537S, MCF7-Y537N (CRISPR knock-in), SUM44PE-wt and SUM44PE-LTED-Y537S; 1 nM E2 vs equal-volume EtOH vehicle, 6 h, 3 biological replicates. Paper line 21: MCF7 Y537N/Y537S clones heterozygous. Paper methods: IMAC TiO2 + Fe-NTA sequential enrichment, Q-Exactive HF-X for phosphoproteome, HCD, DTT/IAA, MaxQuant 1.6.14 with CAM fixed, Met-ox/N-term acetyl/Phospho STY variable, main-search precursor 4.5 ppm. Cellosaurus CVCL_0031 (female, 69Y, pleural effusion) and CVCL_3424 (female, age unspecified, pleural effusion, invasive lobular breast carcinoma) confirmed via API.

file_mapping.evidence: files_compact.json lists 60 RAW + txt.zip + FASTA + design file; all 60 RAW present in comment[data file], none extra, none duplicated. Scripted comparison against experimentalDesignTemplate.ESR1.phosphoproteome.txt: 0 mismatches in fraction and sample (experiment) assignment.

design_consistency.evidence: 30 samples = 5 genotypes/lines x 2 treatments x 3 biological replicates, each with 2 fraction runs (fraction 1/2, TiO2 and Fe-NTA eluates) -> 60 rows; technical replicate 1 throughout; factors cell line/compound/genotype vary as described with each mutant paired to its isogenic WT.

omission_safety.evidence: Every value traced to PRIDE, paper, design file or Cellosaurus; SUM44PE age correctly 'not available'; zygosity claimed only for MCF7 knock-ins where the paper states it. Reconcile MAJOR flag (disease vs 'control arm') is a false positive: vehicle arm is still the same cancer cell line. Omissions noted as minor findings (exposure duration, culture medium).

deterministic_validation.evidence: flock parse_sdrf validate-sdrf (4 templates, OLS cache) exit 0; sdrf-tools check --offline exit 0 CLEAN; sdrf-tools score 98/100; sdrf-tools structure OK; sdrf-tools reconcile: 1 flag reviewed and dismissed.

findings.message: E2/vehicle exposure time of 6 h is documented but not annotated; clinical-metadata guidance pairs compound+dose+exposure duration.
findings.evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol and paper Methods: 'Cells were incubated for 6h before harvesting.' Add characteristics[exposure duration] = 6 hour.

findings.message: Recommended cell-lines column omitted though evidenced.
findings.evidence: PRIDE protocol: MCF7 lines in DMEM (GlutaMAX), SUM44PE lines in RPMI; stimulation in phenol red-free medium with charcoal-stripped FBS.

findings.message: 'invasive breast carcinoma' is a parent of the Cellosaurus disease for MCF-7.
findings.evidence: Cellosaurus CVCL_0031 DI: Invasive breast carcinoma of no special type (NCIT:C4194); acceptable as is, could be made specific.

findings.message: 'estradiol' (CHEBI:23965) is the generic class; 17beta-estradiol (CHEBI:16469) is the E2 used.

Fragment tolerance cites parameters.txt from txt.zip, which is not in the supplied evidence (consistent with MaxQuant FTMS default); PRIDE record lists Q Exactive HF while the paper states Q-Exactive HF-X (SDRF follows the paper, which is appropriate).
